features.name: mean_counter_comment_words
features.definition: What is the mean number of words per counter-argument comment in the row?
features.spec: Parse OC_comments as JSON list of strings; if missing or malformed return null; if empty list return null. For each comment, word count = len(re.findall(r'\S+', comment)). Return the mean across all comments in the list. Raw text count, no semantic filtering; comments may contain outcome announcements.

h0: mean_counter_comment_words has no association with the probability that the OP changed their view (delta).
h1: Higher mean_counter_comment_words is associated with a higher probability that the OP changed their view (delta).
note: Row-level operationalization: per-comment outcomes are not supplied, so the claim is tested at row level using the mean comment length (comment-level winning comment cannot be identified). Maximum length could be an alternative but mean was chosen. Rows with no comments get null. List order has no meaning; comments may include outcome announcements or later replies, and timing is unknown. Association only, OLS on the binary outcome (linear probability).
